subject: Kickoff: Differentiable Data Selection for vision training
body:
Bao, team,

Kicking off the DDS evaluation. The method is a two-step recipe: first train a normal model on CIFAR-10 with Wide-ResNet-28-10, then use it as the representation for a learned DDS scorer that reweights training examples during a second training run. If the published gains transfer to our internal vision corpora, this becomes a standing data-curation lever -- better models from the same data budget, which is the cheapest win we ever get.

Important constraint up front: the implementation only runs on TPUs, so this lives on Cirrus, not the GPU pools.

Milestones: CIFAR-10 reproduction by April 24, internal-corpus pilot by June 5, Q3 investment recommendation before OKR lock.

Bao to size the TPU ask and staffing.

Lucia
